name: Английский язык
program: Типовая учебная программа РК (обновлённое содержание образования). Темы сверять с действующим учебником.

topics.title: Глагол to be и have got
topics.explain: Глагол to be (быть) имеет три формы в настоящем времени: I am, he/she/it is, we/you/they are. В вопросах он ставится перед подлежащим (Are you a student?), в отрицании — с not (She isn't at home). Have got означает «иметь»: I/you/we/they have got, he/she/it has got.
topics.formula: I am · he/she/it is · we/you/they are;  I have got · she has got

medium.e: Вопрос с to be: глагол перед подлежащим.

hard.q: My parents ___ got a big car.
___ your brother got a phone?
Выберите правильное отрицание: «Это не мой рюкзак».

olympiad.q: Найдите ошибку: «My friend and I is in the same class.»
olympiad.e: My friend and I = we → are.

olympiad.q: Everybody ___ here today.
The news ___ good.

topics.title: Present Simple
topics.explain: Present Simple описывает привычки, факты и расписания: I go to school every day. С he/she/it к глаголу добавляется -s/-es (she plays, he watches). Вопросы и отрицания строятся с помощью do/does: Do you like music? She doesn't eat meat. Маркеры: every day, usually, often, sometimes, never.
topics.formula: I/you/we/they play · he/she/it plays;  Do you…? Does she…? · don't / doesn't

medium.q: ___ your mother work in a hospital?

hard.q: Water ___ at 100 degrees.
The bus ___ at 7:30 every morning.
She ___ (study) English and maths.

olympiad.q: Найдите ошибку: «Does he plays tennis?»
Which is correct?
How often ___ your grandparents visit you?

topics.title: Множественное число существительных. Артикли a/an/the
topics.explain: Множественное число обычно образуется с -s (books), после -s, -x, -ch, -sh — с -es (boxes), согласная + y → -ies (cities). Есть исключения: man → men, child → children, tooth → teeth, mouse → mice. Артикль a/an — «один, какой-то» (a cat, an apple — перед гласным звуком), the — «конкретный, известный».

hard.q: Множественное число от mouse?
She is ___ honest girl.
He wants to be ___ engineer.

olympiad.q: It's ___ university in Astana.
Множественное число от sheep?
I play ___ piano and ___ football.
olympiad.e: Музыкальные инструменты — с the, спорт — без артикля.

topics.title: Предлоги места и времени
topics.explain: Предлоги места: in (в), on (на), under (под), next to (рядом), between (между), behind (за), in front of (перед). Предлоги времени: at (at 5 o'clock, at night), on (дни недели и даты: on Monday, on 5 May), in (месяцы, годы, части дня: in July, in 2025, in the morning).

medium.q: The ball is ___ the table (под столом).

hard.q: The bank is ___ the café and the shop.
I was born ___ 2012.
We don't go to school ___ the weekend (брит.).
hard.e: Британский вариант — at the weekend (амер. on the weekend).

olympiad.q: Independence Day in Kazakhstan is ___ 16 December.
Look! There's a bird ___ the tree (сидит на ветке).
olympiad.e: Птица в кроне дерева — in the tree.

olympiad.q: I'll see you ___ night.

topics.title: Лексика: семья, школа, распорядок дня
topics.explain: Базовая лексика: семья (mother, father, brother, sister, grandparents, aunt, uncle, cousin), школа (subject, timetable, classroom, pupil, teacher), распорядок дня (get up, have breakfast, go to school, do homework, go to bed). Время: It's half past seven (7:30), It's quarter to nine (8:45).

medium.q: The son of your aunt is your ___.

hard.q: It's quarter to nine = ?
Which word is NOT a school subject?
Your father's brother is your ___.

olympiad.q: Your mother's mother's son is your ___.
olympiad.e: Сын бабушки по маме — брат мамы, то есть дядя.

olympiad.q: Choose the odd one out:
What do you call the person who teaches you at school (formal)?

topics.title: Present Continuous и Present Simple
topics.explain: Present Continuous (am/is/are + глагол-ing) описывает действие, происходящее сейчас или временно: I am reading now. Present Simple — привычки и факты. Маркеры Continuous: now, at the moment, look!, listen! Глаголы состояния (like, know, want, believe) обычно в Continuous не употребляются.

medium.q: She usually ___ tea, but today she ___ coffee.

hard.q: Форма -ing от swim?
What ___ you ___ at the moment?
Water ___ at 0 °C.

olympiad.q: I ___ (know) the answer.
Найдите ошибку: «She is wanting a new phone.»
He ___ with his grandparents this month (временно).

topics.title: Past Simple: правильные и неправильные глаголы
topics.explain: Past Simple описывает завершённые действия в прошлом: I visited Almaty last summer. Правильные глаголы получают -ed (play → played, stop → stopped), неправильные имеют особые формы (go → went, see → saw, buy → bought). Вопросы и отрицания — с did: Did you see it? I didn't go. Маркеры: yesterday, last week, ago, in 2020.
topics.formula: V-ed / 2-я форма;  Did … + V?  didn't + V

medium.q: She ___ to the party last night.
We ___ in Astana two years ago.

hard.q: Past Simple от stop?
Past Simple от study?
Where ___ you ___ your holidays?

olympiad.q: Найдите ошибку: «I didn't saw him yesterday.»
Past Simple от catch?
Which sentence is correct?

topics.title: Исчисляемые и неисчисляемые. Some/any, much/many
topics.explain: Исчисляемые существительные можно посчитать (an apple, two apples), неисчисляемые — нет (water, money, bread, advice). Some — в утверждениях, any — в вопросах и отрицаниях. Many — с исчисляемыми (many books), much — с неисчисляемыми (much time), a lot of — с обоими.

easy.q: There is ___ milk in the fridge.

medium.q: There aren't ___ students in the classroom.

hard.q: I have ___ friends in Almaty (немного, но есть).
There's ___ sugar left (немного).
Could I have ___ water, please?

olympiad.q: He gave me ___ good advice.
Найдите ошибку: «I don't have many time.»
Very ___ people came, so the hall was almost empty.

topics.title: Степени сравнения прилагательных
topics.explain: Короткие прилагательные: -er и -est (tall — taller — the tallest), с удвоением (big — bigger) и y → i (happy — happier). Длинные: more и the most (more interesting, the most interesting). Исключения: good — better — the best, bad — worse — the worst, far — farther/further. As … as — «такой же … как».

medium.q: This book is ___ than that one.
Khan Tengri is ___ mountain in Kazakhstan.

hard.q: Сравнительная степень от happy?
My bag is as ___ as yours.
This is ___ day of my life!

olympiad.q: The ___ you study, the ___ you know.
Найдите ошибку: «She is more taller than me.»
Which is correct?
o: Today is much colder than yesterday.
Today is very colder than yesterday.
Today is more colder than yesterday.
Today is much more cold that yesterday.

topics.title: Лексика: еда, погода, свободное время
topics.explain: Еда: breakfast, lunch, dinner, vegetables, fruit, meat, bread, soup; национальная кухня Казахстана — beshbarmak, baursaks, kumys. Погода: sunny, rainy, windy, snowy, cloudy, foggy; temperature, degrees. Хобби: reading, drawing, playing chess, swimming, skating.

medium.q: Beshbarmak is a traditional dish of ___.

hard.q: What's the weather like? — It's ___ and minus fifteen.
Choose the odd one out:
«Пить чай с молоком» — как сказать правильно?

olympiad.q: Which phrase is used to order food politely?
A «heatwave» is…
o: a period of very hot weather

olympiad.q: Kumys is made from ___ milk.
olympiad.e: Кумыс — из кобыльего молока (шубат — из верблюжьего).

topics.title: Будущее время: will и be going to
topics.explain: Will используют для решений в момент речи, обещаний и предсказаний без доказательств: I'll help you. It will be cold tomorrow, I think. Be going to — для планов и предсказаний по видимым признакам: I'm going to visit Almaty. Look at the clouds — it's going to rain. Для расписаний используют Present Simple, для договорённостей — Present Continuous.

easy.q: We ___ visit our grandma next week (план).
The phone is ringing. — I ___ answer it!

medium.q: Look at those clouds! It ___ rain.
___ you help me with this box?

hard.q: The train ___ at 6:15 tomorrow (расписание).
I ___ my cousin tonight. We arranged it yesterday.
Which is a promise?

olympiad.q: Найдите ошибку: «I will to call you later.»
By the way, what time ___ the concert start?
«Подожди, я открою дверь» — как сказать?
o: Wait, I'm going to open the door.

topics.title: Present Perfect
topics.explain: Present Perfect (have/has + 3-я форма глагола) связывает прошлое с настоящим: важен результат или опыт, а не время. I have lost my key (сейчас ключа нет). Have you ever been to Turkistan? Маркеры: ever, never, already, yet, just, since, for. С конкретным временем в прошлом (yesterday, in 2020) используют Past Simple.

hard.q: I ___ him yesterday.
We have known each other ___ ten years.
She has ___ left. You've missed her.

olympiad.q: Найдите ошибку: «I have seen this film last week.»
How long ___ you ___ English?
This is the best book I ___ read.

topics.title: Модальные глаголы: can, must, have to, should, may
topics.explain: Can — умение и разрешение (I can swim). Must — сильная обязанность или запрет (mustn't): You must wear a seatbelt. Have to — обязанность из-за обстоятельств (I have to get up early). Should — совет (You should see a doctor). May/might — возможность и вежливое разрешение. После модальных глаголов (кроме have to) — глагол без to.

medium.q: Tomorrow is Sunday. I ___ get up early.
She ___ to wear a uniform at school.

hard.q: He can ___ the guitar.
Прошедшее время от can?
When I was five, I ___ read.

olympiad.q: Чем «mustn't» отличается от «don't have to»?
o: mustn't — запрещено, don't have to — не обязательно

olympiad.q: Найдите ошибку: «You should to drink more water.»
It ___ rain later, so take an umbrella just in case.

topics.title: Наречия. Порядок слов в предложении
topics.explain: Наречия образа действия часто образуются с -ly: quick → quickly, careful → carefully; исключения: good → well, fast → fast, hard → hard. Наречия частоты (always, usually, often, sometimes, never) ставят перед смысловым глаголом, но после to be: She is always late. Порядок слов: подлежащее — сказуемое — дополнение — обстоятельство места — времени.

hard.q: She works ___. She is always busy.
Choose the correct word order:
o: I met my friend in the park yesterday.
I met yesterday my friend in the park.
Yesterday in the park I my friend met.
I in the park met my friend yesterday.

hard.q: Наречие от careful?

olympiad.q: I can ___ hear you. Speak louder!
Найдите ошибку: «She drives very careful.»
Which sentence is correct?
o: I have never been to Japan.
I never have been to Japan.
I have been never to Japan.
Never I have been to Japan.

topics.title: Лексика: путешествия, Казахстан, достопримечательности
topics.explain: Путешествия: journey, trip, luggage, ticket, passport, departure, arrival, sightseeing, souvenir. Казахстан: capital (Astana), steppe, mountains, lake Balkhash, the Caspian Sea, Baiterek, Medeu, Charyn Canyon, Turkistan (mausoleum of Khoja Ahmed Yasawi).

easy.q: Where can you see the Baiterek tower?

medium.q: The mausoleum of Khoja Ahmed Yasawi is in ___.

hard.q: Charyn Canyon is often compared with ___.
Medeu is famous for its ___.
Which is NOT a means of transport?

A «round trip» ticket is…
The Caspian Sea is actually the world's largest ___.

topics.title: Past Continuous и Past Simple
topics.explain: Past Continuous (was/were + V-ing) описывает действие, которое длилось в определённый момент в прошлом: At 8 pm I was watching TV. Часто сочетается с Past Simple: длительное действие прерывается коротким — I was reading when the phone rang. While — «в то время как» (с длительным действием).

easy.q: They ___ football when it started to rain.
What ___ you doing at 10 o'clock last night?

medium.q: I was walking home when I ___ an old friend.
The sun ___ and the birds were singing.

hard.q: When the teacher came in, the students ___.
When the teacher came in, the students ___ (встали после).
I ___ (not / sleep) when you called.

olympiad.q: Which sentence describes two long actions happening at the same time?
o: While I was watching TV, my mum was cooking.
When I watched TV, my mum cooked dinner and left.
I watched TV, then my mum cooked.
I have watched TV while my mum cooks.
olympiad.e: Два параллельных длительных действия — оба в Past Continuous.

olympiad.q: Which sentence shows an interrupted action?
o: I was having a shower when the lights went out.
I had a shower and went out.
I have a shower every day.

olympiad.q: Past Continuous от «they / not / listen»?

topics.title: Present Perfect и Past Simple
topics.explain: Present Perfect — результат или опыт без указания времени, а также действие, начавшееся в прошлом и продолжающееся сейчас (for, since). Past Simple — завершённое действие в конкретный момент прошлого (yesterday, last year, in 2015, ago, when?). Вопрос «When…?» всегда требует Past Simple.

medium.q: She ___ (lose) her keys. She can't open the door.
He ___ here for five years and still lives here.
He ___ there for five years, then moved to Astana.

hard.q: Have you seen the new film? — Yes, I ___ it last weekend.
I ___ him since we were kids.
Shakespeare ___ many plays.

olympiad.q: Найдите ошибку: «When have you arrived?»
o: have you arrived → did you arrive

olympiad.q: «Я уже прочитал эту книгу» (результат):
o: I have already read this book.
I already read this book yesterday.

olympiad.q: This is the first time I ___ sushi.

topics.title: Условные предложения: Zero, First, Second Conditional
topics.explain: Zero Conditional — общие истины: If you heat ice, it melts. First Conditional — реальное будущее: If it rains, we will stay at home (в части с if — Present Simple, не will). Second Conditional — нереальное или маловероятное в настоящем/будущем: If I were rich, I would travel the world (после if — Past Simple, were для всех лиц).
topics.formula: 0: If + Present, Present;  1: If + Present, will + V;  2: If + Past, would + V

easy.q: If it rains, we ___ at home.
If you heat water to 100 °C, it ___.
If I ___ a bird, I would fly.

medium.q: If she ___ hard, she will pass the exam.
If I had a million, I ___ a house.
What would you do if you ___ a lion?

hard.q: Unless you hurry, you ___ the bus.
If I ___ you, I would apologise.
We'll go to the park if the weather ___ nice.

olympiad.q: Найдите ошибку: «If it will snow, we will make a snowman.»
Which is a Second Conditional?
o: If I knew the answer, I would tell you.
If I know the answer, I tell you.
If I knew, I told you.
If I know, I'll tell you.

olympiad.q: If she ___ (not / be) ill, she would come to the party.

topics.title: Страдательный залог (Passive Voice): Present и Past Simple
topics.explain: Страдательный залог используют, когда важнее действие или объект, а не исполнитель: The bridge was built in 1960. Образуется: be + 3-я форма глагола. Present Simple Passive: is/are + V3 (English is spoken here). Past Simple Passive: was/were + V3. Исполнителя вводят предлогом by: The book was written by Abai.

hard.q: Переведите в пассив: «They clean the rooms every day.»
o: The rooms are cleaned every day.
The rooms is cleaned every day.
The rooms were clean every day.

hard.q: Where ___ the Olympic Games ___ in 2024?
The windows ___ (not / wash) last week.

olympiad.q: Почему говорят «My phone was stolen», а не «Somebody stole my phone»?
Найдите ошибку: «The museum was visit by many tourists.»
Rice ___ in Kyzylorda region.

topics.title: Герундий и инфинитив
topics.explain: После некоторых глаголов употребляется герундий (V-ing): enjoy, finish, avoid, mind, like/love/hate (чаще), suggest. После других — инфинитив с to: want, decide, hope, plan, agree, would like. После предлогов всегда герундий: interested in reading. После модальных глаголов — инфинитив без to.

hard.q: I'm looking forward to ___ you.
She avoided ___ about the problem.
I hope ___ the competition.

olympiad.q: Разница: «I stopped to smoke» и «I stopped smoking»?
o: первое — остановился, чтобы закурить; второе — бросил курить

olympiad.q: Remember ___ the door when you leave!
I remember ___ this film as a child.

topics.title: Косвенная речь (Reported Speech)
topics.explain: В косвенной речи время глагола обычно «сдвигается» на шаг назад, если глагол-введение в прошедшем времени: «I am tired» → He said (that) he was tired. Present Simple → Past Simple, Present Continuous → Past Continuous, will → would, can → could, Past Simple/Present Perfect → Past Perfect. Меняются местоимения и слова времени: today → that day, tomorrow → the next day, here → there. Вопросы передаются прямым порядком слов: She asked where I lived.

easy.q: «I am happy», she said. → She said she ___ happy.
«I will help», he said. → He said he ___ help.
«I can swim», Tom said. → Tom said he ___ swim.

medium.q: «We are playing chess», they said. → They said they ___ chess.
«I'll call you tomorrow», she said. → She said she would call me ___.
«Where do you live?» he asked. → He asked where I ___.

hard.q: «I saw this film», she said. → She said she ___ that film.
«Are you ready?» she asked. → She asked ___ I was ready.
«Don't be late!» the teacher said. → The teacher told us ___ late.

olympiad.q: «The Earth goes round the Sun», the teacher said. → The teacher said the Earth ___ round the Sun.
Найдите ошибку: «He asked me where was the station.»
o: where was the station → where the station was

olympiad.q: «I have lived here for years», she said. → She said she ___ there for years.
olympiad.e: Present Perfect → Past Perfect; here → there.

topics.title: Относительные придаточные (Relative Clauses)
topics.explain: Относительные местоимения соединяют придаточное с главным предложением: who — для людей, which — для предметов и животных, that — для людей и предметов (в определяющих придаточных), whose — «чей», where — «где», when — «когда». В неопределяющих придаточных (с запятыми) that не используется: Astana, which is the capital, is modern.

easy.q: The girl ___ lives next door is my friend.
This is the book ___ I told you about.
That's the house ___ I was born.

medium.q: The man ___ car was stolen called the police.
I remember the day ___ we first met.
Abai, ___ was a great poet, lived in the 19th century.

hard.q: The phone ___ I bought last week is already broken.
Almaty, ___ is famous for apples, is in the south.
Is this the shop ___ sells phones?

olympiad.q: В каком предложении нельзя опустить местоимение?
o: The boy who won the prize is my cousin.
The film that we watched was boring.
The book which I read is old.
The cake that she made was tasty.
olympiad.e: Who — подлежащее придаточного, его опускать нельзя.

olympiad.q: Найдите ошибку: «My brother, that lives in Astana, is a doctor.»
The reason ___ I'm late is the traffic.

topics.title: Страдательный залог во всех временах
topics.explain: Пассив образуется по схеме be (в нужном времени) + V3. Present Continuous: is being built. Present Perfect: has been built. Future: will be built. Модальные: can be done, must be finished. В пассив переводят предложения с дополнением; исполнителя (by…) указывают, только если он важен.
topics.formula: is being done · has been done · will be done · can be done

easy.q: A new school ___ in our town now.

hard.q: Переведите в пассив: «They are repairing the road.»
Homework must ___ on time.
By 2030 many new parks ___.

olympiad.q: Найдите ошибку: «The results will announced tomorrow.»
It ___ that the city was founded in the 11th century.
Which sentence does NOT need «by …»?
o: The telephone was invented by Bell.
The picture was painted by Kasteyev.

topics.title: Third Conditional и wish
topics.explain: Third Conditional описывает нереальную ситуацию в прошлом — сожаление о том, что уже случилось: If I had studied, I would have passed the exam. Структура: If + Past Perfect, would have + V3. Wish + Past Simple — сожаление о настоящем (I wish I knew), wish + Past Perfect — о прошлом (I wish I had listened).
topics.formula: If + had + V3, would have + V3;  I wish + Past / Past Perfect

easy.q: If I ___ earlier, I wouldn't have missed the bus.
If she had studied, she ___ the test.

medium.q: I wish I ___ to the concert yesterday.
If we had known, we ___ you.
If it ___ rained, we would have gone to the park.

hard.q: Which sentence is a Third Conditional?
o: If I had seen him, I would have told him.
If I see him, I'll tell him.
If I saw him, I would tell him.
If I see him, I tell him.

hard.q: I wish you ___ so loudly. It's annoying! (жалоба на поведение)
She would have won if she ___ harder.

olympiad.q: Mixed: If I had taken the medicine yesterday, I ___ better now.
Найдите ошибку: «If I would have known, I would have come.»
Which expresses regret about the past?
o: I wish I hadn't said that.
I wish I will say that.
I wish I am saying that.

topics.title: Фразовые глаголы
topics.explain: Фразовый глагол — глагол с частицей или предлогом, который часто меняет значение: give up (бросить), look after (присматривать), look for (искать), turn on/off (включить/выключить), put on (надеть), take off (снять; взлетать), find out (узнать), get on with (ладить), run out of (закончиться).

easy.q: I'm ___ my keys. Have you seen them?

medium.q: Who will ___ the baby while we're out?

hard.q: We've ___ milk. Can you buy some?
I ___ well with my classmates.
Can you ___ this word in the dictionary?

olympiad.q: She ___ her mother — they have the same eyes.
The meeting has been ___ until next week.
It took him a month to ___ the flu.

topics.title: Past Perfect и Past Perfect Continuous
topics.explain: Past Perfect (had + V3) обозначает действие, завершившееся до другого момента в прошлом: When I arrived, the film had already started. Past Perfect Continuous (had been + V-ing) — длительное действие до момента в прошлом: She was tired because she had been working all day.

easy.q: When we arrived, the train ___ already ___.
After she ___ dinner, she went out.
I ___ never ___ snow before I moved to Astana.

medium.q: He was tired because he ___ for hours.
By the time the teacher came, we ___ the task.
She told me she ___ the book.

hard.q: Выберите правильную последовательность: «Я понял, что забыл ключи».
o: I realised that I had forgotten my keys.
I realised that I forgot my keys before.
I had realised that I forgot my keys.
I realise that I had forget my keys.

hard.q: Her eyes were red. She ___.
No sooner ___ I sat down than the phone rang.

olympiad.q: Hardly ___ the match started when it began to rain.
olympiad.e: Hardly … when — Past Perfect с инверсией.

olympiad.q: Найдите ошибку: «When I got home, my parents already had dinner.»
How long ___ you ___ before you found a job?

topics.title: Future Continuous и Future Perfect
topics.explain: Future Continuous (will be + V-ing) — действие, которое будет идти в определённый момент будущего: This time tomorrow I'll be flying to London. Future Perfect (will have + V3) — действие, которое завершится к моменту в будущем: By 2030 I will have graduated. Маркеры: by, by the time, this time next week.
topics.formula: will be + V-ing;  will have + V3

easy.q: This time tomorrow I ___ an exam.

medium.q: By the time you arrive, I ___ the cake.
In ten years, she ___ as a doctor.
___ you ___ the car tonight? I need it. (вежливо о планах)

hard.q: By 2030 scientists ___ a cure for this disease, I hope.
Next month we ___ here for exactly five years.
At midnight I ___ — please be quiet.

olympiad.q: Найдите ошибку: «By next week I will finish the project already.»
When you get this letter, I ___ for Almaty.
Which is correct?
o: I'll be seeing Asel tomorrow, so I can give her your book.
I'll have seen Asel tomorrow at the moment.
olympiad.e: Future Continuous для запланированного хода событий.

topics.title: Модальные глаголы предположения
topics.explain: Модальные глаголы выражают степень уверенности. О настоящем: must be (наверняка), might/may/could be (возможно), can't be (не может быть). О прошлом: must have done, might have done, can't have done. Например: She isn't answering — she must be busy. He can't have seen us — it was dark.

easy.q: He's been working all day. He ___ be tired.
That ___ be Aidar — he's in London now.

medium.q: The window is broken. Someone ___ thrown a ball.
She ___ seen us — she didn't say hello.
I'm not sure where he is. He ___ be in the library.

hard.q: You ___ told me! I would have helped. (упрёк)
The lights are off. They ___ gone to bed.
He ___ have taken the wrong bus — that's why he's late.

olympiad.q: Чем отличается «He must have left» от «He had to leave»?
o: первое — предположение, второе — обязанность в прошлом

olympiad.q: Найдите ошибку: «She must has forgotten.»
It's 30 °C outside. You ___ be cold!

topics.title: Словообразование: приставки и суффиксы
topics.explain: Суффиксы существительных: -tion (inform → information), -ment (develop → development), -ness (happy → happiness), -er/-or (teach → teacher), -ity (able → ability). Прилагательных: -ful, -less, -able, -ous, -al, -ive. Наречий: -ly. Приставки с отрицательным значением: un- (unhappy), in-/im-/il-/ir- (impossible, illegal, irregular), dis- (dislike), mis- (misunderstand).

hard.q: Противоположность regular?
Прилагательное «бесполезный» от use?
Существительное от able?

olympiad.q: Заполните: Kazakhstan gained its ___ (independent) in 1991.
Заполните: The test was ___ (surprise) easy.
Заполните: He was ___ (employ) for a year after college.

topics.title: Лексика: образование, технологии, окружающая среда
topics.explain: Образование: curriculum, degree, scholarship, graduate, tuition fees, Unified National Testing (ЕНТ). Технологии: device, artificial intelligence, software, data, privacy, social media. Экология: pollution, climate change, renewable energy, recycling, endangered species, carbon footprint.

o: a species at risk of extinction
the amount of CO₂ produced by a person or activity

hard.q: Choose the right collocation: ___ a decision.
Choose: ___ research.
«Privacy» in the context of social media is about…

olympiad.q: Odd one out:
Which phrase means «сдать экзамен» (успешно)?
«Tuition fees» are…

topics.title: Смешанные условные предложения
topics.explain: Смешанные условные предложения сочетают разные времена: прошлое условие и результат в настоящем — If I had taken that job, I would be rich now; настоящее (постоянное) условие и прошлый результат — If I were braver, I would have spoken to her. Также используют inversion: Had I known, I would have come = If I had known…

easy.q: If I had slept well last night, I ___ tired now.
If she spoke English, she ___ the job last year.
___ I known, I would have helped.

medium.q: If he hadn't missed the flight, he ___ in Paris now.
___ I you, I would accept the offer.

hard.q: If I weren't afraid of heights, I ___ the mountain with you yesterday.
Had they left earlier, they ___ the traffic.
But for your help, I ___ the exam.
hard.e: But for = if it hadn't been for.

olympiad.q: Найдите ошибку: «If I would have studied medicine, I would be a doctor now.»
Перепишите с инверсией: «If it were not for the rain, we would go out.»
o: Were it not for the rain, we would go out.
Was it not the rain, we go out.
Had it not for the rain…

olympiad.q: Supposing you ___ the lottery, what would you do?

topics.title: Инверсия для усиления
topics.explain: Инверсия (вспомогательный глагол перед подлежащим) используется после отрицательных и ограничительных наречий в начале предложения для эмоционального усиления в формальной речи: Never have I seen such a beautiful place. Not only did he win, but he also broke the record. Only then did I understand. Seldom does she complain. Little did they know…

easy.q: Not only ___ late, but he also forgot the tickets.

medium.q: Little ___ they know what was coming.
Rarely ___ so many people at the concert.

hard.q: Under no circumstances ___ open this door.
Not until I got home ___ that I'd lost my wallet.
hard.e: Not until … + инверсия в главной части.

hard.q: So beautiful ___ the view that we stopped the car.

olympiad.q: Найдите ошибку: «Hardly I had arrived when it started to rain.»
o: Hardly I had → Hardly had I

olympiad.q: No sooner ___ the bell rung than the pupils ran out.
Which sentence is grammatically correct?
o: At no time did she mention it.
At no time she mentioned it.
At no time she did mention it.
At no time mentioned she it.

topics.title: Артикли: сложные случаи
topics.explain: Без артикля: названия большинства стран (Kazakhstan), городов, языков, приёмы пищи, виды спорта, абстрактные понятия в общем смысле (Life is beautiful). С the: страны-объединения (the USA, the UK, the Netherlands), океаны, моря, реки, горные цепи (the Tien Shan), пустыни, группы островов, уникальные объекты (the Moon), музыкальные инструменты, превосходная степень, порядковые числительные.

easy.q: ___ Caspian Sea is the largest lake in the world.

medium.q: ___ Tien Shan mountains are very high.
___ Mount Everest is the highest peak.

hard.q: He went to ___ prison to visit his uncle (не как заключённый).
___ life is full of surprises.
She is ___ best student in our class.

olympiad.q: ___ rich should help ___ poor.
Which is correct?
o: She speaks the Kazakh and the English.
She speaks the Kazakh language and English language.

olympiad.q: We had ___ lunch at noon, and it was ___ delicious lunch.
olympiad.e: Приём пищи — без артикля, но с прилагательным — a.

topics.title: Эссе и аргументация (Academic Writing)
topics.explain: Аргументативное эссе состоит из введения (тема и позиция — thesis statement), основной части (аргументы с примерами, контраргумент) и заключения. Связующие слова: firstly, moreover, furthermore, however, on the other hand, therefore, in conclusion. Академический стиль избегает сокращений (don't → do not) и разговорных слов.

hard.q: Which linking word shows result?
Choose the correct sentence:
o: Despite the rain, we went out.
Despite of the rain, we went out.
Despite it rained, we went out.
Although of the rain, we went out.

hard.q: Какой абзац должен содержать одну главную идею?

olympiad.q: Which phrase is appropriate for hedging (смягчения) in academic writing?
Найдите ошибку: «In conclusion, there is many reasons to learn languages.»
Что такое плагиат?
o: выдача чужого текста за свой без указания источника

topics.title: Идиомы и устойчивые выражения
topics.explain: Идиомы — выражения, значение которых не равно сумме значений слов: break the ice (начать разговор, снять неловкость), a piece of cake (очень легко), hit the books (усердно учиться), once in a blue moon (очень редко), under the weather (неважно себя чувствовать), cost an arm and a leg (очень дорого), let the cat out of the bag (выдать секрет).

easy.q: «The test was a piece of cake» means the test was…

o: to start a conversation in an awkward situation

medium.q: «This phone cost an arm and a leg» means it was…

hard.q: «Let the cat out of the bag» means…
«It's raining cats and dogs» means…
«To be on cloud nine» means…

olympiad.q: Which idiom means «держать в курсе»?
«To cut corners» means…
o: to do something cheaply or carelessly
to take a shortcut while walking only

olympiad.q: «Pull someone's leg» means…
